name: com.rustyxr.gargoyle.video.android
description: Optional Unity package for Gargoyle video control, video-lab telemetry, and diagnostic RXYRVID1 H.264 packet receiving. Native Android decode-to-texture glue is intentionally separate from the core Gargoyle package.

samples.description: Minimal controls for requesting Gargoyle video-lab status and synthetic H.264 streams.
